rules.title: h1
rules.notes: The generic rungs take about half the article. The page's #content also holds the sticky In this article table of contents, which reads as duplicated headings once reflowed; the body element alone is the article. Code samples live in the shadow root of an <mdn-code-example>, and once that shadow content is inlined the sample's toolbar comes with it — the language badge and the copy button reflow into a stray "JS Copy" line above every block.
